name: NavList
purpose: Structure persistent, optionally grouped and collapsible navigation lists with current-destination state.
useWhen: A sidebar, rail, drawer, or page region contains a persistent list of routes, optionally grouped into sections.

avoidWhen.condition: Navigation opens disclosure panels from a top bar or switches local tab panels.

composition: Compose Root > List > Item > Link; use Section with SectionLabel and SectionContent, adding SectionTrigger only when the section is actually collapsible.

rules.statement: Use Link parts for destinations and expose the current destination through the component contract.
Use a SectionTrigger only when it controls the associated SectionContent.
Style collapsible SectionContent from its data-state and measured content-size hooks; Atom keeps exit content mounted through the animation lifecycle.

commonMistakes.mistake: Using generic clickable rows for routes or adding a disclosure trigger to a static heading.
commonMistakes.correction: Use NavList.Link for routes and SectionLabel alone for non-collapsible groups.

validation: Confirm navigation and section labels are meaningful and current state matches the route.
Confirm collapsed content is not keyboard reachable and trigger state is announced.
